name: Ascension
audio: rolling thunder, crackling electricity, a rising orchestral hit and a dragon roar; no speech
world: The storm-watch hall is alive: lightning flashes through the windows, rain and sparks blow in, copper coils crackle, the floor sigil pulses and static lifts dust from the stones.

actions.beat: Lightning forks through the tall windows and runs along the copper coils, the sigil in the floor igniting in {{MAGIC}} light.
{{She}} raises the staff and cups a ball of lightning in {{her}} free hand as arcs leap between {{her}} hands and the sigil ring, {{her}} hair lifting with static.
Fulgora thrusts its head through the windows and roars as lightning blasts across the hall, and {{she}} turns an intense, knowing look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
